buffer.notes: Only autonomous publisher for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Use official Buffer API and publication ledger.

metricool.notes: Use Free-plan analytics/MCP as the social measurement layer. Existing Buffer services remain analytics-only in Metricool. Bluesky, Threads and Pinterest are discovery candidates, but automatic publishing remains disabled until each account is connected and the single-publisher safety gate assigns ownership.

dev-community.manualRequirement: one-time RSS import configuration and per-post quality review if DEV requires it
dev-community.notes: DEV officially supports RSS import and canonical URLs. Good fit for technical/searchable English guides. Avoid purely promotional posts.

pinterest.notes: High fit for visual calculators, checklists and evergreen guides because Pins can be found through search and saved for later. Connect only if no recurring manual burden is introduced.

bluesky.notes: Open public network with reposts and custom feeds. Good for timely Signal/AI topics; avoid duplicate publishing ownership conflicts.

threads.notes: Supports external profile links and link performance insights. Candidate for discovery/conversation once account ownership and publishing lane are confirmed.

note.notes: Use note internal keyword/title/body/hashtag discovery and existing paid articles. Folio Junction routes to approved note assets after links are supplied.

line-official.notes: Treat LINE Official Account primarily as retention/re-contact, not top-of-funnel discovery. Search/recommendation visibility depends on account settings and verification. Use only for the matching vertical; never mix unrelated identities.

google-business-profile.notes: Do not create a fake/virtual location. Google requires eligible businesses to interact with customers in person; online-only brands are not eligible. Reconsider only for a genuine service-area business that visits customers.

reddit.notes: Do not automate self-promotion. Use only when a specific community permits it and there is genuine non-promotional participation.
